messages:
kim: DeployBot just fired an urgent canary alarm in ap-east1 — p50 doubled and a few 502s. tagging @oncall_leah @oscar for an expedited call.

oscar: I'm on it, pulling traces. Any quick mitigation that avoids global rollback?

oncall_leah: pin-region is fastest. Need consensus in 10m. If we pin, ops will route new sessions to pinned pool.

deploybot: Canary summary -> failures=5, p50-ms=360 (baseline ~160ms), error-rate=0.7%. Actions: `pin` or `rollback`. Use `/deploy fast-approve <action>` to proceed.

kim: My plan: pin ap-east1 to `redwood/serve:2026.03.05-stable` (last known good). If pin works, run a 20m elevated canary.

oscar: traces show an I/O syscall regression on a subset of hosts after today's infra image. No artifact/model diffs. +1 for pin.

oncall_leah: executing pin now:
`/deploy pin --region ap-east1 --image redwood/serve:2026.03.05-stable --reason "expedite-pin: post-deploy IO perf regression" --approver oncall_leah`

releasebot: Pin accepted. Rolling pin in ap-east1. Expected completion ~4 minutes. Notifying on-call and release owners.

infra_team: flagged correlation with auto-image job #img-7781. Creating INFRA-4692 and adding host-ids and perf traces.

deploybot: Pin progress: 9/9 hosts pinned. Health checks: passing. Telemetry: p50 returning to baseline within ~80s. Error-rate reduced to 0.09%.

kim: good. Can someone run a short synthetic against pinned pool to confirm stability? 5m at 3qps should do.

oscar: queuing synthetic now. Will paste results in 4.5m.

docs_writer: release notes already published for the rollout. If we revert regionally I can add a single-line amendment: "Temporary revert of infra image in ap-east1 due to performance regression; ongoing investigation." Want PR now or wait until pin completes?

oncall_leah: please open the PR so we can merge quickly if pin stabilizes.

docs_writer: PR -> https://git.internal/docs/PR-1357. Short blurb and changelog entry added.

oscar: synthetic finished: p50 stable, no 5xx observed across 5m sample.

infra_team: INFRA-4692 created and assigned to infra-lead. Kernel/image team looped in for root cause.

kim: thanks. We'll keep canary sensitivity elevated for 24h. If alerts reappear we'll consider a global rollback.

oncall_leah: marking expedited action complete. Leaving auto-rollback disabled while infra triages.

releasebot: Release-note PR merged and changelog updated.

oscar: filing a follow-up to add a perf gate to the image pipeline. INFRA-4693 created.

kim: closing this thread for now. If anything new pops up, reopen here or ping oncall. :thumbsup:
